discovery_notes: Follow-up to packet 243 (b109); reuses its keys and 208's 2019 keys. 27 searches. Holds released: Villains S2 structure (per-pin Evil Queen/Jafar headings), Conducting Mickey structure (D/E/F named pins). Kept: Captain Hook Pulse match, Neo Nouveau S1, LE 200 Dec 2019. Out of window seen: Sharing a Dream (2021-03), Blue Fairy jumbo (2021-01), Horned King jumbo (2021-04), Neo Nouveau S2 (2021-02), Princess & Friends S3 (2021-04).
